text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and B at gains felt satisfying, but I should not sell just to make a gain feel real; decide using a plan, not my purchase price.","A recent rise or fall does not predict the next move, so I should avoid treating this short record as evidence of a trend.","Set clear portfolio and risk rules in advance, then review periodically; neither fear of admitting a mistake nor discomfort with a loss should decide whether I hold or sell."]}
